# push-loops.txt -- every timer loop of the tree, named (the class rule in
# internal/ci/push_not_poll_class_test.go, TestEveryTimerLoopIsNamedInThePushTable).
#
# One line per loop: `<file> <func> <row>`, the func as the scanner names it
# (Recv.Name for a method), the row the first cell of a row of the table in
# docs/SPEC-SPRINT.md, section "Push, not poll". A line is an inventory entry,
# never an excuse: the row says what the loop is, and a timer poll's row names
# the card that makes it push or the measured reason it stays. A loop that
# stops waiting on a clock (it became a push) has its line deleted in the same
# change; a new timer loop gets its line, and its row, in the change that adds it.

# the friend's daemon (internal/friend, cmd/nova-friend)
